rawContent: 📢@Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz, where is the #climate leadership you promised us? Increase 🇩🇪's funds for international #climatefinance as promised NOW to €6bn & by 2025 to €8bn per year! Allocate 50% of the money to adaptation measures. @GlblCtznDe
